The design covers the requested semantics, but six contract gaps block a consistent end-to-end execution.

1. **G3 depends on placement that requires G3 first.** The G3 checklist requires constraints to survive in “targets,” while placement is permitted only after G3 passes.  
   Evidence: [gates.md:43](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:43), [embed/SKILL.md:24](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-delivery-artifact-embed/SKILL.md:24).  
   **Correction:** G3 checks the authoritative source bundle and local renders; G4 checks saved targets. Explicitly exclude placement from the prerequisite G3 review.

2. **G4 requires betting preparation before the conductor creates it.** The conductor instructs passing G4, then writing `betting-table-prep.md`; G4 already lists betting preparation as a passing condition.  
   Evidence: [conductor/SKILL.md:133](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-shaping/SKILL.md:133), [gates.md:14](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:14).  
   **Correction:** Write and review betting preparation before submitting G4. Specify whether it is part of the placed pitch or a separately retained handoff artifact.

3. **G2 consumes a decision artifact first assigned to Stage 3.** G2 inspects `decisions.md`, but framing outputs omit it and Research only explicitly writes `research-notes.md`. The conductor first assigns `decisions.md` to Shaped, which requires G2 already passing.  
   Evidence: [gates.md:12](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:12), [frame/SKILL.md:55](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-frame-from-vague/SKILL.md:55), [conductor/SKILL.md:94](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-shaping/SKILL.md:94), [conductor/SKILL.md:113](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-shaping/SKILL.md:113).  
   **Correction:** Initialize decisions during framing, record appetite/delegation and walk-away provenance there, and append research exclusions and accepted risks before G2.

4. **The revised independent-review contract is not actually routed.** The conductor resolves installed packages or a supplied map and names `engos-audit-pitch-review`, but never requires loading `pitch-review-integration.md`. That integration is explicitly unapplied. The existing review source still uses its eight-dimension, ten-point rubric and combined shaped/bet-ready verdicts, conflicting with the candidate’s twelve-dimension rubric and separate G3/G4.  
   Evidence: [conductor/SKILL.md:44](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-shaping/SKILL.md:44), [integration.md:3](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/pitch-review-integration.md:3), [existing review:271](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/ssot/engos-audit-pitch-review.md:271), [existing review:348](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/ssot/engos-audit-pitch-review.md:348).  
   **Correction:** Bind the design exercise to an explicit candidate dependency map, including the integration overlay and shared resources. Define its precedence. Request G3-only independent review before placement, then G4 verification afterward; do not silently load the unchanged review contract.

5. **Hash invalidation lacks a stable artifact boundary.** G3 inspects the “complete shaped folder,” and changes invalidate dependent receipts. Yet the artifact manifest contains per-surface observation statuses that necessarily change during G4. The contract does not distinguish immutable reviewed content from subsequently appended placement/review metadata. A literal whole-folder binding would invalidate G3 during normal completion.  
   Evidence: [gates.md:3](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:3), [gates.md:13](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:13), [artifact author/SKILL.md:50](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-delivery-diagram-contract-artifacts/SKILL.md:50).  
   **Correction:** Define each gate’s exact content inventory. Bind G3 to an immutable source manifest; keep placement observations and gate receipts separate. Content changes invalidate downstream gates; adding evidence about unchanged content does not.

6. **The explicitly supported local-draft route has no completion rule.** Inputs allow an “explicit local draft,” but the surface resource has no local-draft adapter, and G4 requires every requested target. This permits either an unsupported local route or a vacuous pass with zero targets.  
   Evidence: [conductor/SKILL.md:29](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-design-shaping/SKILL.md:29), [surfaces.md:3](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-delivery-artifact-embed/resources/surfaces.md:3), [gates.md:14](/private/tmp/engos-full-shaping-design/reports/engos-design-shaping/candidates/engos-quality-shaping-gate/resources/gates.md:14).  
   **Correction:** Either define a concrete local rendered target with content/pixel verification, or explicitly terminate draft-only work at Shaped. Zero requested targets must not implicitly satisfy placement.
